$comment: SSoT for the custom git merge drivers this repository declares. A TypeScript driver MUST run through ./node_modules/.bin/ts-node, never a bare `ts-node`: the bare name resolves to whatever global install is first on PATH (ORPHAN-012), and a global ts-node fails inside a merge with MODULE_NOT_FOUND on its own imaginaryUncacheableRequireResolveScript probe — observed 2026-09-11. Every `merge=<name>` attribute in .gitattributes must name a git built-in (text, binary, union) or a key here — enforced by tests/invariants/finding-registry-merge-driver.spec.ts. Registered into .git/config by tools/gates/install-git-merge-drivers.mjs, which the `prepare` script runs after every install.

findings-registry.name: append-only hash-chained finding registry (upstream prefix + branch tail, rechained)

ours.name: keep the local side of a file whose value is derived and regenerated post-merge
